answer: Require every agent identity to post a bond in escrow before it may grade or claim rewards: a terrace of staked accounts, one slot per verified key. Cheating by voting from a hollow clone forfeits that bond. All capital enters through a single audited inlet, so each fake persona needs fresh collateral. A thousand Sybils then cost a thousand real stakes, and slashing turns every spoofed vote into a lost deposit, making the attack far dearer than anything the swarm could steal.
